title: Model servers
lead: Install Ollama, vLLM and SGLang next to the Studio. A ready server registers itself as a shared AI provider.
disabled: Installing next to the Studio is turned off by the cluster administrator (modelServers.local.enabled).
noDocker: The Studio cannot see Docker: model servers cannot be installed without it.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.lead: We use it to suggest which engine and model fit.

reason.docker_gpu_unsupported: Docker does not pass the GPU to containers
reason.arch_unsupported: CPU architecture is not supported by the images
reason.size_unknown: could not determine the model size
reason.cpu_only: will be very slow without a GPU

install.title: New server
install.lead: Pick an engine and a model. Before downloading we show whether it fits.

modelHint.ollama: An Ollama library tag, for example qwen3:8b.
modelHint.vllm: A Hugging Face id, for example Qwen/Qwen3-8B.
modelHint.sglang: A Hugging Face id, for example Qwen/Qwen3-8B.

install.name: Provider name

estimate.summary: Weights about {{weights}}, about {{needed}} with room for context; {{available}} available ({{kind}}).
estimate.rough: The estimate is approximate: real usage depends on the context length.

server.registered: Registered as a shared AI provider.
server.notResponding: The server is running, but the model has not answered yet: it may still be loading into memory.

remove.title: Remove server
remove.description: The container and the AI provider will be removed. Downloaded models stay on disk.

error.generic: That did not work. Try again.

error.model_server_docker_unavailable: Docker is not available to the Studio.
